tasks.question: Which SIGCHI policy documents were updated in 2014?
tasks.reference_answer: The policy regarding the Doctoral Consortium at the CHI conference was updated on June 1, 2014.
tasks.prediction: The SIGCHI policy document explicitly listed as updated in 2014 was the Doctoral Consortium Policy for the CHI Conference (listed on the conference policies page as “Doctoral Consortium for the CHI Conference”), last updated June 1, 2014. Note: the “Complimentary Registration, Conference Courtesies, and Conference Support Guidelines” had a June 1, 2014 effective date, but it was last updated Aug 8, 2019, so it is not counted as updated in 2014.

tasks.question: In 2024, how did Rovio express a commitment to its community through its actions in reviving classic games and supporting the Brazil Nut Corridor conservation?
tasks.reference_answer: Rovio announced plans to bring back classic Angry Birds games due to fan demand and supported the Brazil Nut Corridor conservation through the Wild Green Future's Annual Charity Battle.
tasks.prediction: In 2024, Rovio expressed a community-oriented commitment through its support for conservation: its official article dated February 11, 2024 says Rovio/Angry Birds donated to Wild Green Future’s annual charity battle, which supported the Brazil Nut Corridor in Peru through the Alliance for a Sustainable Amazon. The donation was to help expand work with Brazil nut concessionaire families by providing training, planning assistance, seedlings, and follow-up support. However, the classic-game revival was not a 2024 action. Rovio’s revival effort—the #BringBack2012 campaign and Rovio Classics: Angry Birds—was announced in 2021 and launched in March 2022 as a remastered recreation of the original game, explicitly in response to fan and community requests. In 2024, Rovio instead marked Angry Birds’ 15th anniversary with in-game events and said it loved seeing the Angry Birds community continue to grow.
